BundleSource.description: A public source cited by the bundle (gauge totals, event timeline, tide table).

note.description: What number was taken and how.
note.title: Note

BundleSource.title: BundleSource

description: One card on the replay page (``GET /v1/replay/bundles``).

baked.description: True when every cycle exists under data/runs.
baked.title: Baked

built.description: True when every member the bundle's label requires is on disk. False means the folder is a stub and the card says 'Generated by make bundle'.
built.title: Built

calibration_basis.description: How the bundle's calibration numbers were arrived at, verbatim from the manifest. This is the basis text the replay page shows under a reconstructed replay (docs/SIMPLIFICATIONS.md, replay window accumulation).
calibration_basis.title: Calibration Basis

design_storm_basis.description: Why the design storm is not a fitted IDF curve, verbatim from ``manifest.design_storm.basis``. None on bundles that carry no design storm (docs/SIMPLIFICATIONS.md, design storms).
design_storm_basis.title: Design Storm Basis

missing_members.description: Required members that are not on disk yet, e.g. ['gauges.csv'].
missing_members.title: Missing Members

sources.description: The public sources the bundle cites, so the card can link them instead of only counting them (SPEC.md 0.7).
sources.title: Sources

tide_source.description: Where the tide series came from: a published table, or 'illustrative' when the stage is modelled from a single sourced height.
tide_source.title: Tide Source

title: ReplayBundleSummary
